h: JPMorgan reportedly enters Nigeria and appoints a former CBN governor as a director
p: Global bank JPMorgan has reportedly begun operations in Nigeria. The move is said to include the appointment of a former Central Bank of Nigeria governor to its local board. The development is being read by many as a sign of renewed foreign interest in the Nigerian financial market.
more: The appointment of a former central bank chief is drawing attention in banking circles.
Details of the licence and the scale of the planned operations were not immediately clear.
